title: FAQ & knowledge base
subtitle: Answers about QR reports, tasks and teams in WinProx.

qr_scan.title: Scan QR and report
qr_scan.body: Visitors scan the unit QR and submit the report form. The issue reaches your facility team immediately.

issues.title: Managing issues
issues.body: Issues lists new, in-progress and closed reports. Approve, assign teams and log follow-up.

tasks.title: Tasks and follow-up
tasks.body: Create tasks for internal teams from an issue. Teams complete work via the team portal or app.

teams.title: Internal teams
teams.body: Teams group colleagues and workers. Link teams to units and issues to route work correctly.

locations.title: Locations and units
locations.body: Locations are sites; units are spaces or assets each with their own QR code for reporting.

notifications.title: Issues and status
notifications.body: Statuses follow the workflow: new, in progress, done and closed. Filters help you prioritise.

calendar.title: Calendar and planning
calendar.body: Recurring tasks and planned work appear in the calendar per team.

subscription.title: Subscription and trial
subscription.body: New organisations start with a trial. Administrators activate a plan under Subscription.
